sections.voiceover: A nanny's lawsuit ended in a $1.27 million penalty.
b_roll: Financial graphic displaying $1.27 million penalty figure

sections.voiceover: In 2022, Ericka Genaro sued Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde in Los Angeles Superior Court. The court forced the wrongful termination lawsuit into private arbitration. What happened to all 8 of her claims?
b_roll: Graphic of Los Angeles Superior Court document filing dated 2022
Motion graphic depicting transfer into private arbitration
Graphic display showing 8 dismissed claims list

sections.voiceover: Instead of winning, the arbitrator dismissed all 8 claims entirely.
b_roll: Motion graphic showing counter reaching 0 out of 8 claims remaining

sections.voiceover: The arbitrator awarded Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde over $1.27 million in fees and costs. Both actors filed a petition in New York to confirm the ruling. That filing confirms their legal victory.
b_roll: Chart depicting $1.27 million total legal fees and costs awarded
Map animation highlighting legal petition filing in New York
Document graphic showing confirmed arbitration ruling

sections.voiceover: Now, they've petitioned a New York court to formally confirm the $1.27 million award.
b_roll: Split status graphic indicating confirmed arbitration award alongside pending New York court confirmation
